name: tally
description: Tracks a repository's API keys by metadata without ever reading a key

scripts.gate: biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun scripts/changelog.ts --check && bun src/index.ts --config .tally.yaml validate
scripts.gate:changed: { git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=d "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)"; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard; } | xargs -0 -r biome ci --no-errors-on-unmatched && tsc --noEmit && bun test --changed=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) && bun scripts/changelog.ts --check && bun src/index.ts --config .tally.yaml validate
